result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major content/localization problem where a raw string key is shown as a section title.

issues.description: The section heading below 'Fastest near you' displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title, exposing an internal string key to users.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with its localized value (e.g., 'Popular near you'), fix the i18n lookup/fallback for this key, and add a check to prevent untranslated keys from rendering in production.
